items.name: NIC: Disable Adapter Power Management (all physical adapters)
items.description: Uses NetAdapter cmdlets to disable adapter-level power management on physical NICs.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ Disable-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $n.Name -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name * | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

items.name: NIC: Disable Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) where present
items.description: Enumerates advanced properties and disables EEE only on adapters that expose the property.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ $props=Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $targets=$props|?{ $_.DisplayName -match 'Energy Efficient Ethernet|EEE' -or $_.RegistryKeyword -match 'EEE' }; foreach($p in $targets){ Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Output 'EEE pass complete.'

items.name: NIC: Disable Green Ethernet where present
items.description: Disables Green Ethernet or similarly named power-saving properties per adapter when exposed.

steps.command: $patterns='Green Ethernet','Green','Power Saving'; $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ $props=Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $targets=$props|?{ $dn=$_.DisplayName; ($patterns|%{ $dn -like "*$_*" }) -contains $true }; foreach($p in $targets){ if($p.RegistryKeyword){ Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }; Write-Output 'Green Ethernet pass complete.'

items.name: NIC: Disable Idle/Ultra-Low-Power Modes where present
items.description: Targets common vendor labels (idle power saving, reduce speed on power down, ultra low power) only when properties exist.

steps.command: $re='Idle Power|Reduce Speed|Power Down|Ultra Low|Auto Disable Gigabit|Gigabit Auto'; $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ $props=Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ? { $_.DisplayName -match $re -or $_.RegistryKeyword -match 'Idle|PowerDown|Ultra|Gigabit' }; foreach($p in $props){ if($p.RegistryKeyword){ Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }; Write-Output 'Idle power mode pass complete.'

items.name: NIC: Export Full Advanced Property Inventory
items.description: Exports all adapter advanced properties for dynamic OEM/vendor discovery.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $dir=Join-Path $PWD 'logs'; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir|Out-Null}; $out=Join-Path $dir ("nic-advanced-properties-"+$ts+".json"); $data=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $name=$_.Name; [pscustomobject]@{ Adapter=$name; Properties=(Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) } }; $data|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $out; Write-Output "Saved: $out"

items.name: NIC Power Management: Disable Device Sleep Allowance
items.description: Disables 'Allow computer to turn off this device' where supported.

steps.command: Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object Status -eq 'Up' | ForEach-Object { Disable-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $_.Name -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

items.name: NIC Advanced: Disable Gigabit Auto Disable / Auto Power Save
items.description: Attempts to disable common vendor properties that downshift link speed for power savings.

steps.command: $keys='*EEE','*GreenEthernet','*AutoDisableGigabit','*AutoPowerSaveModeEnabled','*IdlePowerSaving','*UltraLowPowerMode'; Get-NetAdapter | ForEach-Object { $n=$_.Name; foreach($k in $keys){ try { Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n -RegistryKeyword $k -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } }

items.name: NIC Wake Cleanup: Disable Wake-On-Pattern Offloads
items.description: Disables wake-on-pattern features while leaving manual wake management explicit.

steps.command: Get-NetAdapter | ForEach-Object { $n=$_.Name; try { Set-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $n -WakeOnMagicPacket Disabled -WakeOnPattern Disabled -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }

items.name: NIC: Export Adapter Power-Management State
items.description: Dumps NetAdapter power-management state for all adapters.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir|Out-Null}; $out=Join-Path $dir ("nic-power-management-"+$ts+".txt"); Get-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name * -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List * | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $out; Write-Output "Saved: $out"

items.name: NIC: Re-enable Adapter Power Management (Balanced fallback)
items.description: Re-enables adapter PM for users leaving max-performance profile.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ try{ Set-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $n.Name -AllowComputerToTurnOffDevice Enabled -ErrorAction Stop } catch{} }; Get-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name * | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output
